description: This file implements the Administrator class within the Thunder::RPC namespace, managing IPC channels, proxies, stubs, and interface registration/unregistration for RPC communication. It includes methods for reference counting, proxy management, validation, and cleanup of channels and proxies.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and interface registration for IPC communication within Thunder::RPC.

methods.name: ~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for an interface on a channel.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for an interface on a channel.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Completes a proxy call, finalizing the response.

methods.name: UnregisterUnknownProxy
methods.description: Removes a proxy from internal tracking.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation of methods based on interface and method IDs.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates if an implementation instance is associated with a channel.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given implementation and interface on a channel.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given implementation and interface.

methods.name: RegisterUnknown
methods.description: Registers a new interface implementation with a channel.

methods.name: UnregisterUnknown
methods.description: Unregisters an interface implementation from a channel.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts raw implementation pointer to IUnknown based on stub ID.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel and cleans up associated proxies and references.
